coverage.reason: Limit the discrete zoom hit-size variable to actual city, camp, march and pickup hit areas so changing map detail no longer invalidates all map descendants. Preserve existing 58/84/110px hit targets, LOD thresholds, selection, animations and camera logic. The new browser regression checks computed targets and absence of variable inheritance into artwork/labels, coalesced wheel bursts with 150 cities/100 marches at normal and 4x CPU, reversed native touch pinch anchors and settling, and screenshots at desktop and two landscape sizes. Shared input and pickup validators protect click/gesture behavior; the Map Atlas browser test covers desktop wheel, touch pinch, navigation and drag-click suppression; Tower browser tests protect fixed-size action positioning while zooming. Existing action and historical phase-2 validators must recognize the narrower variable scope. Historical screenshot resolution is made checkout-independent and regenerated diagnostic output goes to ignored release-artifacts instead of rewriting committed baseline evidence. No server, authority, economy, topology or gameplay-rule changes, so no emulator suite applies.
